title: Pentagon press release denying the Kandahar giant story

tellings.quote: that I saw something that looked like an official like press release from the Pentagon saying the Kandahar giant story is not true.

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the Kandahar giant, a story that American soldiers met and killed a giant about 12 feet tall in Afghanistan. Alberino says he saw something that looked like an official press release from the Pentagon, the US Defense Department, saying the story is not true. He raises it as part of the back and forth over whether the story is real.
